data.title: Rejection of sick pay (Krankengeld) before 22 January 2026
data.summary: Muster BKK, David Muster's statutory health insurer, denies sick pay (Krankengeld) for the period from 12 January 2026 because the incapacity certificate was not reported within one week; sick pay will instead only be paid from 22 January 2026, the date the certificate arrived.
data.explanation: Your health insurer says your sick pay claim was suspended because your incapacity was reported late, so they will only pay from 22 January 2026 instead of 12 January 2026. If you disagree — for example because the delay was not your fault — you can file a written objection (Widerspruch) with Muster BKK. The app will show the deadline computed from this letter. If you do nothing by then, this decision becomes final and you lose the right to challenge the missing days of sick pay. Consider getting advice from a social counselling service (Sozialberatung) if you think the late reporting was excusable.
